response.sql: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) as type_avg FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), overall_avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) as overall_avg FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL), kept_types AS (SELECT ta.production_type_code, ta.type_avg FROM type_averages ta CROSS JOIN overall_avg_cte WHERE ta.type_avg > overall_avg_cte.overall_avg), kept_mean_cte AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) as kept_mean FROM kept_types), final_types AS (SELECT kt.production_type_code, kt.type_avg FROM kept_types kt CROSS JOIN kept_mean_cte WHERE kt.type_avg > kept_mean_cte.kept_mean) SELECT AVG(ft.type_avg) as avg_type_price, AVG(ft.type_avg - oa.overall_avg) as avg_distance_from_overall, AVG(ft.type_avg - km.kept_mean) as avg_distance_from_kept_mean FROM final_types ft CROSS JOIN overall_avg_cte oa CROSS JOIN kept_mean_cte km
